title: Contract Gallon Pre-Buy — Booking Window, Gallon Limits and Expiry Terms
content:
The pre-buy terms below are part of the catalogue for Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts. For each programme they fix the month and day the booking window opens and closes, the smallest booking the programme will take, the ceiling on booked gallons as a share of the member's prior-year use, the month and day unused contracted gallons expire on, the treatment the catalogue writes against gallons unused at expiry, and the charge for cancelling gallons before they are drawn.

| Programme | Window opens | Window closes | Smallest booking, gallons | Ceiling, percent of prior-year use | Unused gallons expire on | Treatment written against gallons unused at expiry | Cancellation charge, USD per gallon |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Will-Call Propane Account | not offered | not offered | 0 | 0 | not offered | not applicable | 0.00 |
| Keep-Full Automatic Delivery Account | not offered | not offered | 0 | 0 | not offered | not applicable | 0.00 |
| Budget Payment Plan Account | not offered | not offered | 0 | 0 | not offered | not applicable | 0.00 |
| Contract Gallon Pre-Buy Account | 1 May | 31 August | 1000 | 120 | 31 August | credited at the lower of the contracted and the posted price | 0.15 |
| Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery Account | 1 November | 28 February | 2500 | 110 | 31 December | rolled into the following contract year | 0.10 |
| Cardtrol Fleet Fueling Account | 1 November | 28 February | 5000 | 100 | 31 December | rolled into the following contract year | 0.10 |

## Notes to the terms

1. Three of the six programmes do not carry pre-buy at all. On the Will-Call Propane, Keep-Full Automatic Delivery and Budget Payment Plan Accounts the window is not offered, the smallest booking and the ceiling stand at 0, the treatment column is not applicable, and the cancellation charge stands at 0.00 USD per gallon.
2. On the Contract Gallon Pre-Buy Account the window runs from 1 May to 31 August and gallons expire on 31 August. On the Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery and Cardtrol Fleet Fueling Accounts the window runs from 1 November to 28 February and gallons expire on 31 December.
3. The smallest booking rises with the programme, standing at 1000 gallons, 2500 gallons and 5000 gallons on the three programmes that carry pre-buy; the ceiling on booked gallons falls across the same three, standing at 120 percent, 110 percent and 100 percent of the member's prior-year use.
4. The treatment column is the term the catalogue writes for the programme against gallons left unused at expiry. It reads "credited at the lower of the contracted and the posted price" on the Contract Gallon Pre-Buy Account and "rolled into the following contract year" on the Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery and Cardtrol Fleet Fueling Accounts. It is a programme term in the catalogue and not a statement of the handling basis, which is settled where that basis is written.
5. The cancellation charge stands at 0.15 USD per gallon on the Contract Gallon Pre-Buy Account and at 0.10 USD per gallon on the other two programmes that carry pre-buy.
